Tracker blocking
Block trackers

Off unless you turn it on. Watch stops apps you installed from reaching the hosts of tracker SDKs: their lookups get no address, and their connections are refused. A host that also serves the app itself is not blocked.
Apps that came with the phone, Android itself and Google Play services are not covered.
Also block in browsers
Browsers are not blocked unless you include them: they open any website.
Also block your tool\'s own tracker lookups
Off unless you turn it on. Watch then answers your tool\'s own lookups of tracker hosts with no address. It never refuses the tool\'s connections: the names they show can be any popular website.
